mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (name, email, age, password, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{age}, #{password}, #{role}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, age = #{age}, password = #{password}, role = #{role}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, email, age, password, role, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
